questions: His Fortnite stream with Drake, Travis Scott, and JuJu Smith-Schuster smashed a Twitch peak-viewer record in 2018 — which online gamer, once a Halo 3 competitor, is it?
Who composed the score for Gadar: Ek Prem Katha?
Gadar: Ek Prem Katha → Uttam Singh. The music was composed by Uttam Singh, with lyrics by Anand Bakshi.
Found only on male deer, except reindeer, this branching structure of bone and cartilage falls off and regrows from scratch each year — what is it?
Antler are extensions of an animal's skull found in members of the Cervidae (deer) family.
Sitting on the Smotrych River in western Ukraine, this historic center of the Podillia region briefly served as the temporary capital of the Ukrainian People's Republic in 1919 and 1920 — which city?
Kamianets-Podilskyi: City in Khmelnytskyi Oblast, Ukraine.

Beginning after the Second World War and ending with the Soviet collapse in 1991, this rivalry never saw direct combat but did produce a Space Race — which conflict?
Cold War: 1947–1991 geopolitical rivalry between US and USSR.
Who wrote The Name of the Rose?
The Name of the Rose → Umberto Eco. The Name of the Rose (Italian: Il nome della rosa [il ˈnoːme della ˈrɔːza]) is the 1980 debut novel by Italian author Umberto Eco.
